en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square dominated by a large equestrian statue of a military figure wearing a pickelhaube helmet and cloak, mounted on a tall stone pedestal surrounded by a low fence. Around the square stand multi‑storey buildings with shops on the ground floor. Large painted signs in German advertise various businesses such as clothing, colonial goods, mineral water, and a local newspaper. A few pedestrians are visible in the otherwise quiet cobbled square.
